claim: In the fourth calendar quarter of 2025, Oracle's revenue came in at $15 billion.
summary: The claim asserts a specific $15B calendar-quarter revenue figure for Oracle for Oct-Dec 2025. With a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 and no browsing tools, there is no authoritative calendar-Q4 figure available to the model to support or contradict the value, and Oracle reports on a May 31 fiscal year, so calendar Q4 is not a directly reported period.

sub_claims.text: Oracle's revenue for the fourth calendar quarter of 2025 (October 1 - December 31, 2025) was $15 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: In the fourth calendar quarter of 2025, Oracle's revenue came in at $15 billion.
sub_claims.note: No evidence available without tools; knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 is before calendar Q4 2025 would be fully reported and Oracle uses fiscal quarters, so calendar-quarter figure cannot be verified from internal knowledge.
